title: Warehouse Conveyor High-Frequency Scanner
description:
In an automated fulfillment center, a scanner continuously registers package IDs as they travel along a high-speed conveyor belt. To optimize physical placement near dispatch docks, the warehouse control system must analyze a batch scan log represented by an integer array `package_ids` and extract the top `k` package IDs that appeared most frequently.

Write an efficient algorithm to determine these `k` most frequent package IDs. You may return the result in any order. It is guaranteed that the set of top `k` frequent package IDs is unique for the given test cases.
constraints: 1 <= k <= number of unique package IDs in package_ids
input_format: The input consists of an array of integers `package_ids` representing the recorded package IDs and an integer `k`.
output_format: Return an array of `k` integers containing the most frequently occurring package IDs.

examples.explanation: Package ID 101 appears 3 times, 202 appears 2 times, and 303 appears 1 time. The 2 most frequent package IDs are 101 and 202.
There is only 1 package ID present in the log, so the most frequent package ID is 55.
All three package IDs (7, 8, and 9) appear with an identical frequency of 2. Since k = 3, all unique package IDs are returned.
